pricing.faq1Q: Can I upgrade or downgrade my plan later?
pricing.faq1A: Yes! You can switch plans at any time. When upgrading, the price difference is prorated. When downgrading, the change takes effect at the end of your current billing cycle.
pricing.faq2Q: What happens when my free trial ends?
pricing.faq2A: When your trial ends, you'll be asked to choose a paid plan to continue using smart replies. Your templates and settings are preserved — nothing is lost.
pricing.faq3Q: Can I cancel my subscription anytime?
pricing.faq3A: Absolutely. You can cancel anytime from your account settings. Your plan stays active until the end of the current billing period.
pricing.faq4Q: What payment methods do you accept?
pricing.faq4A: We accept all major credit and debit cards (Visa, Mastercard, American Express) through Stripe, our secure payment provider.
pricing.faq5Q: What happens when I reach my smart reply limit?
pricing.faq5A: When you reach your monthly smart reply limit, template-based replies continue working normally. Only AI-powered smart replies pause until your limit resets at the start of the next billing cycle. You can upgrade anytime for more replies.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.metaDescription: Privacy Policy for Jawab24 - Smart Auto-Reply for Facebook & Instagram Pages
privacy.introText: Jawab24 ("we", "our", or "us") is committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and safeguard your information when you use our Facebook and Instagram auto-reply service at jawab24.com.
privacy.collectText: When you use Jawab24, we collect:
privacy.collectItem1: Facebook and Instagram Account Information: Your name, email, and profile picture when you log in with Facebook.
privacy.collectItem2: Facebook Page and Instagram Account Data: Information about Pages and Instagram accounts you manage, including page name, ID, and access tokens.
privacy.collectItem3: Comments and Messages: Content of comments and messages on your connected Pages to provide auto-reply functionality.
privacy.collectItem4: Business Information: Any business details you provide to customize AI-generated replies.
privacy.useItem1: Provide and maintain our auto-reply service
privacy.useItem2: Generate intelligent responses to comments and messages
privacy.useItem4: Communicate with you about service updates
privacy.geoText: We may collect and process limited geolocation information, such as IP-derived country or region, for purposes of security, fraud prevention, and compliance with legal and regulatory obligations, including sanctions and payment restrictions. This processing is based on our legitimate interests and, where applicable, our obligation to comply with applicable laws.
privacy.shareText: We do not sell your personal information. We may share data with:
privacy.shareItem1: OpenAI: Comment/message content is sent to OpenAI to generate replies. This data is processed according to OpenAI's privacy policy.
privacy.shareItem2: Meta (Facebook & Instagram): We interact with Meta's APIs to read and respond to comments and messages on your Facebook Pages and Instagram accounts on your behalf.
privacy.shareItem3: Service Providers: We use cloud hosting providers to operate our service.
privacy.securityText: We implement industry-standard security measures including encryption, secure servers, and access controls to protect your data. However, no method of transmission over the Internet is 100% secure.
privacy.retentionText: We retain your data for as long as your account is active or as needed to provide services. You can request deletion of your data at any time by contacting us.
privacy.rightsText: Under the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), you have the right to:
privacy.rightsItem4: Disconnect your Facebook Pages and Instagram accounts
privacy.rightsItem5: Revoke Facebook or Instagram permissions at any time. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the Swedish Authority for Privacy Protection (Integritetsskyddsmyndigheten, IMY) at imy.se
privacy.deletionText: To delete your data, you can either:
privacy.deletionItem1: Log into Jawab24 and delete your account from settings
privacy.deletionItem2: Remove the Jawab24 app from your Facebook settings
privacy.deletionItem3: Contact us at the email below
privacy.changesText: We process your data based on: (a) your consent when you connect your Facebook/Instagram account, (b) contractual necessity to provide our auto-reply service, and (c) legitimate interests for security, fraud prevention, and service improvement. We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of any changes by posting the new policy on this page and updating the "Last updated" date.
privacy.contactText: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us at:
privacy.corporateAddress: Registered Address: Bergavägen 15 A lgh 1002, 241 39 Eslöv, Sweden

about.title: What is Jawab24?

intro.title: What is Jawab24?
intro.text: Jawab24 is an AI-powered auto-reply platform built specifically for Arabic-speaking and bilingual businesses. It connects to Facebook Pages, Instagram business accounts, and e-commerce stores on Shopify and Salla, reads incoming comments and direct messages, and automatically replies to customers in their language — Arabic or English — 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.
intro.text2: Jawab24 is not a chatbot — it is an intelligent auto-reply system designed for Arabic-first businesses. Unlike chatbots that follow rigid decision trees, Jawab24 understands context, recognizes Arabic dialect groups, integrates natively with Salla, and uses a built-in safety system to prevent the AI from inventing prices or unsupported facts. Every AI-generated reply passes through 6 automated post-validation checks before it is sent.

about.subtitle: Jawab24 is an AI auto-reply tool that helps businesses automatically reply to Facebook comments, Instagram messages, and customer questions using artificial intelligence.

howItWorks.title: How Jawab24 Works
howItWorks.text: When a customer writes a comment on your Facebook post or sends a message to your page, Jawab24 processes it through a 3-layer reply system:
howItWorks.layer1Text: You create reply rules with keywords. When a customer's message matches a keyword, the system sends your pre-written template reply. Fast, predictable, and free of AI cost.
howItWorks.layer2Text: If no template matches, the AI generates a custom reply based on your Knowledge Base, product catalog, store policies, and conversation history. It uses advanced large language models to understand the customer's intent — whether they're asking about a product, filing a complaint, or just saying hello — and crafts a natural, on-brand response in the same language and dialect the customer used.
howItWorks.layer3Text: Outside your business hours — or when auto-reply is turned off — the system sends a friendly away message so your customers know you're not ignoring them.

platforms.title: Supported Platforms
platforms.text: Jawab24 connects to the platforms where your customers are:
platforms.facebook: Facebook Pages — auto-reply to comments and Messenger messages
platforms.instagram: Instagram Business Accounts — auto-reply to comments and DMs
platforms.shopify: Shopify — sync your product catalog so the AI can answer product questions with accurate prices, descriptions, and availability
platforms.salla: Salla — sync your product catalog from Salla stores, the leading Arabic e-commerce platform

knowledgeBase.title: Knowledge Base
knowledgeBase.text: The Knowledge Base is your AI's brain. You write sections describing your business — return policy, shipping info, FAQs, product details — and the AI uses this information to generate accurate replies.
knowledgeBase.text2: The system uses RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) to find the most relevant knowledge for each customer question. This means the AI only uses information you've provided, reducing hallucination and keeping replies accurate.
knowledgeBase.feature1: Organize knowledge into sections with titles and content
knowledgeBase.feature2: Version history — restore previous versions if needed
knowledgeBase.feature3: RAG-powered search finds the right context for each question
knowledgeBase.feature4: Product catalog from Shopify or Salla is automatically included

ecommerce.title: E-Commerce Integration
ecommerce.text: Jawab24 connects directly to your Shopify or Salla store to sync your product catalog. When a customer asks about a product, the AI can:
ecommerce.feature1: Answer with the correct price, description, and availability
ecommerce.feature2: Suggest relevant products based on the customer's question
ecommerce.feature3: Handle "how much is..." and "is this in stock?" questions automatically
ecommerce.feature4: Two-tier price hallucination detection: verifies every number adjacent to currency symbols (SAR, $, etc.) against your actual catalog, and catches price-cue phrases like "starts at" or "costs" followed by unverified numbers. If a price isn't in your catalog, the AI sends a safe fallback instead of a wrong price.

smartReply.title: Smart Reply Features
smartReply.text: The AI-powered Smart Reply system goes far beyond simple keyword matching. In internal testing across 125 real-world scenarios — including Arabic dialects, sarcasm detection, price questions, complaints, and edge cases — Jawab24 achieved 99.6% evaluation accuracy:
smartReply.feature1: Understands 6 Arabic dialect families (Gulf, Egyptian, Levantine, Maghrebi, Iraqi, and Modern Standard Arabic) plus mixed Arabic-English messages
smartReply.feature2: Classifies every message into 8 intent categories: question, compliment, complaint, purchase intent, greeting, business inquiry, offensive, or spam
smartReply.feature3: Adjustable reply style: Professional, Casual, or Enthusiastic — with optional brand voice notes to match your tone
smartReply.feature4: Three-level confidence scoring (high, medium, low) — low-confidence replies are automatically held for human review instead of being sent
smartReply.feature5: Full conversation context — the AI reads previous messages and consolidates rapid-fire messages into a single coherent reply
smartReply.feature6: Customer awareness — recognizes returning customers by name, remembers past conversation topics, and adjusts its greeting accordingly

templateReply.title: Template Replies & Rules
templateReply.text: For common questions, you can create keyword-based reply rules:
templateReply.feature1: Set keywords that trigger automatic replies (e.g., "price", "shipping")
templateReply.feature2: Multiple reply variations per rule — the system rotates them for natural responses
templateReply.feature3: Choose whether to reply as a comment or a private message
templateReply.feature4: Apply rules to specific pages or all pages at once

bilingual.feature1: Full Arabic and English interface with RTL layout support
bilingual.feature2: AI replies in the customer's language automatically
bilingual.feature3: Greeting and away messages are auto-translated to both languages
bilingual.feature4: Knowledge Base content works in both languages

analytics.feature1: See all comments and messages across all connected pages

analytics.feature4: Filter by page, date, reply type, and read/unread status

mobile.text: Jawab24 is available as a mobile app for Android (iOS coming soon). The mobile app gives you full access to your dashboard, settings, and conversations — with real-time push notifications when customers message you. You get immediate alerts when the AI flags an angry customer, detects a low-confidence reply that needs your review, or encounters a question it can't answer from your Knowledge Base.

security.feature4: Sentry error tracking for reliability monitoring

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.a1: Jawab24 offers a free trial. After the trial, paid plans are available starting at an affordable monthly rate. All plans include AI smart replies and template replies.
faq.a2: Yes. Jawab24 supports both Facebook Pages and Instagram Business Accounts. It can auto-reply to comments and direct messages on both platforms.
faq.a3: Yes. Jawab24 is built for Arabic-first businesses. The AI understands Arabic (including dialects), replies in Arabic, and the entire interface supports right-to-left layout.
faq.q4: Does it integrate with Shopify and Salla?
faq.a4: Yes. You can connect your Shopify or Salla store to sync your product catalog. The AI uses your product information to answer customer questions with accurate prices and availability.
faq.a5: Jawab24 uses confidence scoring. When the AI is uncertain, it flags the reply for human review instead of sending an incorrect response. It also checks for hallucinated prices to ensure accuracy.
faq.q6: Can I control what the AI says?
faq.a6: Absolutely. You control the AI through your Knowledge Base (what it knows), reply rules (keyword-based responses), reply style settings (professional, casual, or enthusiastic), and business hours (when it's active).
faq.q7: How does Jawab24 handle Arabic dialects?
faq.a7: Jawab24's AI can recognize and reply in 6 Arabic dialect families: Gulf (Saudi, Emirati, Kuwaiti), Egyptian, Levantine (Syrian, Lebanese, Jordanian), Maghrebi (Moroccan, Tunisian, Algerian), Iraqi, and Modern Standard Arabic. It detects which dialect the customer is using and replies naturally in the same dialect. It also handles Franco-Arabic (Arabic written in Latin letters) and mixed Arabic-English messages.
faq.q8: Can Jawab24 answer product pricing questions from my Shopify or Salla store?
faq.a8: Yes. When you connect your Shopify or Salla store, Jawab24 automatically syncs your product catalog (names, prices, variants, and stock status) every 6 hours. When a customer asks "how much is the blue shirt?" the AI looks up the exact price from your catalog and replies with accurate information. If the product isn't in your catalog, the AI says "let me check" instead of guessing — it never makes up a price.
faq.q9: What happens when Jawab24 doesn't know the answer?
faq.a9: When the AI can't find an answer in your Knowledge Base or product catalog, it assigns a low confidence score and responds with something like "Let me check with the team and get back to you." If you have the hold-low-confidence setting enabled, the reply is held for your manual review before being sent. The system also tracks which questions it can't answer, and after 3 occurrences of the same unanswered question, it notifies you so you can update your Knowledge Base.
faq.a10: Yes. Jawab24 has native integration with Salla, the leading Arabic e-commerce platform. You connect your Salla store via OAuth, and Jawab24 automatically syncs your product catalog, prices, product availability, and store policies (shipping, returns, warranty). The AI uses this data to answer customer questions accurately. Salla tokens are automatically refreshed so the connection stays active.
faq.q11: Can I use Jawab24 for multiple Facebook pages?
faq.a11: Yes. You can connect multiple Facebook Pages and Instagram Business Accounts to a single Jawab24 workspace. Each page has its own Knowledge Base content, and reply rules apply across the workspace. The AI maintains separate context for each page, so replies are always relevant to the specific business.

whyDifferent.title: Why Jawab24 Is Different
whyDifferent.text: Jawab24 is not a chatbot — it is an intelligent auto-reply system. Traditional chatbots force you to build conversation flows manually and follow rigid decision trees. Jawab24 understands what customers are asking, checks your product catalog for accurate information, and generates natural responses — all without any flow setup. It combines keyword-based templates, AI-generated replies, product catalog data, and business knowledge into a single system that works in Arabic and English. Designed from the ground up for Arabic-speaking markets, with native Salla integration, dialect-aware AI, and right-to-left interface support.
